name: Sweat Tent Portable Outdoor Sauna
description: The original Sweat Tent is a portable wood-fired sauna that delivers real 200°F+ heat anywhere you can build a fire. No construction, no permits, no electrician, no plumbing. Set it up in 15 minutes, light the stove, and step in. The multi-layer insulated tent holds heat below freezing temperatures, and the patented design has been tested in backyards, mountain cabins, and beach trips by over 10,000 owners. Wood-fired heat reaches temperatures electric and infrared can’t match, with zero EMF and real Finnish steam (löyly). Whether you’re recovering from training, building a daily wellness ritual, or sweating with friends, this is the sauna that goes wherever you do.
